title: Surreal Eye of the Frog
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large central eye with a green frog pupil, blooming from a sunflower-like form that drips colorful paint. In the foreground, a green dog stands on cracked earth looking upward, surrounded by melting flowers and a picket fence, while three glowing robed figures appear in a golden field under a dramatic red and green cosmic sky with a castle and house in the distance.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic landscape featuring a giant blooming flower with a detailed human eye and green frog pupil at its center, dripping vibrant paint. A green dog stands on cracked ground looking up at the eye. Melting red, yellow and blue flowers grow around a broken wooden fence. Three glowing robed figures with halos stand in a golden wheat field. Red and green nebula sky with dripping clouds, large orange sun, distant house and castle on a hill.
